name: Knee to chest
summary: On your back, hug one knee toward the chest and hold.
setup: Lie on your back, side-on to the phone at floor level, working leg nearest. Draw the knee toward the chest with both hands and hold, the other leg straight or bent.
brief: Lie on your back. Draw the working knee toward the chest with both hands and hold, the other leg straight or bent.
why: From the side the hip angle closes as the knee comes in, so the timer runs while the knee is actually held close.
tempo: Draw in over a breath; hold; release.
regression: Hold behind the thigh instead of over the shin.
contraindications: Hip pinching at the front, or pain down the leg.

faults.label: Pulling on the shin
faults.tip: Pulling on the front of the shin compresses the knee. Hold behind the thigh instead.

faults.label: Head and shoulders lifting
faults.tip: The knee comes to you; you do not go to the knee. Rest the head.

faults.label: Yanking the knee
faults.tip: Draw steadily; the muscle lets go only if the pull is gentle.

faults.label: Lifting the head
faults.tip: Curling the head up adds neck strain and does nothing for the hip or back.

guide.stop: Pain down the leg, or pinching in the hip.
guide.cannotSee: How hard the hands are pulling.

points.t: Knee held close to the chest.
